何を以ってしても、埋めることの叶わない$虚無感が私を苛んでいる。$愚かしいことだ: My teacher once told me about a crest$that holds the power of a demon. That$crest is here in my hand now. Where in$the world did I get it? These past few$days are nothing but a blank...
輝いた瞳、つやつやしい唇、$陶磁器のような肌…、それらを兼ね備えた$娘の代わりと: But that's not what's important right$now. If what my teacher told me is true,$my salvation is near. I can use the$power of this crest to resurrect my$daughter's soul...!
周りを囲む、醜い失敗作の山。$うつろな瞳、乾いた唇、ひび割れた肌…$人の形をした: There's been a change. Some of my$failures have developed wills of their$own and started talking! This is the$crest's power! I can feel my spirits$lifting. I named the talking dolls.

深くは考えまい。$師匠の話が本当ならば、$私は救いを得ることが出来る。$紋章の力: My hope has turned to conviction. My$daughter will be reborn! All I need now$is a vessel for her soul...
変化が起きた。何体かの失敗作が、$意思を持って喋りだしたのだ。$これが紋章に秘め: The doll is ready...my masterpiece. A$lovely doll, with features just like my$daughter's. I'll finish the process in$the cellar. I've put a code lock on the$door to keep out intrusions.
いつも一人ぼっちの「レベッカ」。$嘘ばかりついている「イレーナ」。$人をだますの: At last I can be with my daughter again!

ん…？$今、何か言った？: Yes, please, Miss. Could you tell us the$code?

アンタたちも希望をなくしちゃダメだよ。$辛いことばかりでも、きっといつかは$むく: Don't you get discouraged either. Even$when everything seems bad, something$good can come along...
畑の小麦はすくすくと育ってるよ。$今年は久しぶりにたくさん収穫できそうだ。$楽し: The wheat in the fields is growing well.$Looks like we'll finally have a good$harvest this year. I can't wait.
秋になって肌寒くなってきたせいかね、$村に幽霊が出るって噂なんだよ。$しかも、ジ: The chilly autumn winds have brought$rumors of a ghost in this village! And$they say it's Jeanne's ghost!
私にも聞こえたんだよ、ジャンヌの声が。$とっても優しくて、$心が救われる声だった: I heard Jeanne's voice too. She sounded$so kind and gentle, I felt my spirits$beginning to lift...
こうして働いてないと、気が変になっち$まうんだ。あの出来事を思い出してよ。$いや: If I don't keep working like this, I$feel like I'm gonna go crazy. I just$wanna forget everything.

村も少しは活気が戻ってきただろ？$あれからもう、半年ちかくたつもんな。$早いもん: The village is looking a little$livelier, don't you think? It's been$nearly half a year since then...

おお、ウル！$お、俺、ジャンヌを見たんだ！: Oh, it's Yuri! I-I saw Jeanne!

ジャンヌ、ありがとう！$いつでも声をかけてくれよ！: Thank you, Jeanne! Come back and talk to$me often, you hear?
俺はまだ、皆のように働く気になんてなれ$ない。家族を奪われ、一人残ったところで、: I just can't get up the urge to work$like everybody else yet. I lost my whole$family. I lost the will to live...
よう！$俺も今度、村を出ることにしたよ。$兵隊になって前線へ行くんだ。: Hello, there! I've decided to leave the$village. I'm gonna be a soldier, and go$to the front.
そう決めたら、$ずいぶんと気持ちが楽になってさ。$はは、不思議なもんだね。: I feel so much better now that I've made$up my mind. He he. Pretty strange,$huh?

どうしたらいいか、わからないんだ。: I don't know what to do.
戦場になんか行くな、って止めた方がいい$のか、それとも笑顔で送り出してやる方が$: Should I try to stop him from going to$the front, or should I send him off with$a smile?
結局、笑顔で送り出してやったよ。$あいつ、もう戻って来ないつもりだ。$わかってた: I finally decided to send him off with a$smile. He doesn't plan on coming back. I$knew that, but I didn't stop him...
はは、ジャンヌの幽霊に励まされたよ。$戦争に行ったトールのやつは、天国で$幸せに: Ha ha! Jeanne's ghost came to cheer me$up. She said Thibault, the one who went$off to war, is now happy up in heaven.
さあ、俺も明日からは頑張って働くぞ！$いつまでもしょげていたら、ジャンヌに$恥ず: I'm really going to throw myself into my$work now! I can't be all dejected$forever. I want to make Jeanne proud!
ウル、それに、ブランカ！？$あんたたち、生きてたのか！？$良かったな！: Yuri?! And Blanca?! You guys are alive?!$I'm so glad to see you!
あの時の焼き討ちで、村人の多くが犠牲に$なっちまった。思い出すと怒りや悔しさで$: They burned down the village. Most of$the villagers died. I just shake with$rage whenever I think about it...!
でも今は、生き残った者たちで、$村を復興する事に全力を注いでるんだ。$くよくよし: But now the survivors are pouring their$energy into rebuilding the village. No$use in wallowing in sorrow.
なに、ロシアに行ってたって？$そりゃまた、ずいぶんと遠い所だな。: What? You were in Russia? Such a faraway$place...

え？ 今度は日本に行ってきた？$日本て、あのアジアの果ての島国かい？$そりゃすご: What? Now you've been to Japan and back?$Japan is that island country on the far$edge of Asia, right? Very impressive!
